record.name: UCSF Valley Center for Vision
names: UCSF Valley Center for Vision -- west building (OCII plan block 33)
record.summary: A real, standing UCSF building on OCII plan block 33, between 3rd St and Illinois St, west of Illinois St -- about 60-100m from the already-tracked Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision tower at 490 Illinois St, across the street. The owner directly identified this building as also being Valley Center for Vision. No independently published source (a UCSF page, news outlet or Regents document) naming this specific west-of-Illinois-St structure was found in this pass; the identification rests on the owner's own knowledge, recorded in the geometry file's own digitization_method log.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL BUILDING, APPROXIMATE BOUNDARY -- a real, standing structure clearly visible in Esri satellite imagery (not open land), identified by the owner as UCSF's Valley Center for Vision. Boundary is the real-gap-fragment's own traced edge (following the street buffer's curb radius) with one corner re-derived to the real street angle (see digitization_method), not a hand-traced or surveyed building footprint. OPEN QUESTION, not resolved in this pass: this project already tracks a separate, already-committed record also named 'Valley Center for Vision' at 490 Illinois St (data/manual/mission_bay_490_499_illinois.geojson), about 60-100m east of this polygon, across Illinois St. The owner has directly and repeatedly confirmed this west-of-Illinois-St building is also Valley Center for Vision; whether it is a second wing/annex of the same named facility, a distinct building that happens to share the name, or a misidentification of one of the two, has not been independently verified against a primary source in this pass -- flagged here rather than silently merged or silently treated as unrelated.
notes.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) between 3rd St and Illinois St, south of 16th St. The owner directly identified this whole real-gap fragment (fragment 6, 12,421 sqm raw) as capturing two separate real buildings, not one, and directed cutting it at the visible gap between the two rooflines in Esri satellite imagery (lat 37.76578).

open_questions: This project already tracks a separate, independently sourced record also named Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St (data/records/mission_bay_490_499_illinois.json), about 60-100m east of this building, across Illinois St. That record's own 2017 UC Regents source describes a single 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and a 3-story north wing at 490 Illinois St -- it does not mention a separate west-of-Illinois-St building. Whether this west building is a second wing/annex of the same named facility built later, a distinct building that happens to share the name, or a misidentification of one of the two records, has not been resolved against any primary source in this pass -- flagged here rather than silently merged with, or silently treated as unrelated to, the 490 Illinois St record.

2026-09-22, new data point (not a resolution): re-running this project's own DataSF business-registration spatial join (src/join_retail.py, out/retail_needs_review_approximate.csv) after this record's geometry was added shows several registrations -- Buenafe #2, All May See, All May See Foundation, Simon Fung -- whose registered point-location falls inside THIS west building's polygon, but whose own listed street address is '490 Illinois St' (the other, east-of-Illinois-St tower's address), not a west-of-Illinois-St address. This could mean the two buildings genuinely share one administrative/mailing address, or it could simply be a DataSF geocoding artifact (a coarse or shared geocode for a multi-building campus) -- the join is spatial-only and 'never auto-confirmed' per that script's own docstring, so this is logged as a data point for a future pass, not treated as confirming the relationship either way. Notably, the same join's matches for the neighboring ucsf_bayfront_medical_building and ucsf_illinois_street_garage records DO show addresses consistent with their own already-sourced identities (520 Illinois St and 590 Illinois St respectively), which is corroborating, not contradictory, evidence for those two.

No address, opening date, architect, cost or square footage for this specific west building was found in this pass; every fact this project has for 'Valley Center for Vision' construction, cost and massing lives in the 490 Illinois St record instead, and may or may not apply here.

Geometry: this building's east edge (its own real, digitized boundary) sits close to, but not necessarily exactly on, Illinois St's west curb line -- not independently verified against DataSF Building Footprints or an Assessor parcel in this pass; see the geometry file's own accuracy_caveat.
record.notes: OCII plan block 33. Between 3rd St and Illinois St, south of 16th St, immediately east of UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (across 3rd St), west of Illinois St. See accuracy_caveat for the unresolved naming question against the 490 Illinois St record.
